dedupe_keys.name: lidh966 gdrom generic data driven reservoir operation model

description: Donghui Li and Yanan Chen publish GDROM, a Python reservoir-operation model combining a hidden Markov model with decision trees. The June 2023 Zenodo release archives version 1.0.0. The inspected GitHub README supplies training and rule-export notebooks, an Echo Reservoir example and environment requirements. It reports application to 452 large reservoirs across the contiguous United States. GDROM can derive operating rules for hydrological simulations from historical records; exact observation periods depend on the input reservoir. Zenodo labels the archive Other Open, while the current repository explicitly states MIT. The README requires modified hmmlearn code and reports an installation issue with hmmlearn 0.2.3 on Apple M1 computers; compatibility was not tested here. A first-review draft covers the derived HydroShare operating-rule dataset, which is a separate output, not this training software. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. Trained rules describe past operations and need checking before use under changed conditions.
